title: Three-query PCPP proof length
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n>0$ input bits. The proof length of its three-query PCPP description is the sum of the quadratic PCPP proof length for $C$ and $64$ times the description size of the associated four-query PCPP system.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits
